item.title: decrypt
item.description: Decrypts an encrypted bytes value created with encrypt using AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption. A 256-bit decryption key is derived from the given key using SHA-256, and the embedded GCM authentication tag is verified before returning the plaintext. If the encrypted data is malformed or decrypted with an incorrect key, a bad_data_err is raised. This function does not generate a change. Function bytes.decrypt(key) Arguments Argument Type Description key str or bytes The non-empty secret passphrase or binary key used when encrypting the data.

item.title: encrypt
item.description: Encrypts the bytes value using AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption. A 256-bit encryption key is derived from the given key using SHA-256, and a fresh 12-byte random initialization vector (IV) is generated on each call. The resulting byte sequence contains a 1-byte version header, the 12-byte IV, the 16-byte GCM authentication tag, and the ciphertext. This function does not generate a change. Function bytes.encrypt(key) Arguments Argument Type Description key str or bytes A non-empty secret passphrase or binary key used to encrypt the data.

item.title: len
item.description: Returns the length of the bytes value. This function does not generate a change. Function bytes.len() Arguments None Return value Returns length of the byte sequence. Example This code uses len() to return the length of a byte sequence: bytes("abc").len(); Return value in JSON format 3
